# Data samples: gdelt-events

Every data type of `gdelt-events` as a real record of the committed test data, every field explained from its data contract, the fields only other rows have and a checklist for the production query. The [index](README.md) lists every domain.

- [event-country](#event-country)

<a id="event-country"></a>

## World events by country: event-country (GDELT)

What the world's news reported about one country yesterday (GDELT): events, tone, conflict, categories, the world map by tone, the top stories. One row per world events by country, keyed by EVENT_COUNTRY_ID. Read by the **gdelt-events** pack's connector `gdelt-store` (lake table `gdelt.event-country`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/economy/gdelt-events/samples/event-country.jsonl`, 13 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/economy/gdelt-events/samples/event-country.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `EVENT_COUNTRY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `ISO3`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `DATE`, `EVENTS`, `MENTIONS`, `AVG_TONE`, `AVG_GOLDSTEIN`, `CONFLICT_SHARE` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AVG_GOLDSTEIN` | number | required | The average Goldstein scale of the day's events: the theoretical impact of the event type on a country's stability, -10 (most conflictual) to +10 (most cooperative). | unit: Goldstein scale points (-10 to +10) | `1.0946` |
| `AVG_TONE` | number | optional (filled in every row) | GDELT's tone of the articles reporting the events (-100 very negative to +100 very positive; most fall between -10 and +10), weighted by mentions. | unit: tone points (-100 to +100) | `-2.8054` |
| `AVG_TONE_WINDOW` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The mention-weighted average tone over the window. | unit: tone points (-100 to +100) | `-2.2956` |
| `BY_CATEGORY` | array of objects | required | The day's events by CAMEO root category, the most first (CODE, CATEGORY, EVENTS, AVG_TONE). | — | [15 objects] |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].AVG_TONE` | number | required | GDELT's tone of the articles reporting the events (-100 very negative to +100 very positive; most fall between -10 and +10), weighted by mentions. | unit: tone points (-100 to +100) | `-1.9561` |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].CATEGORY` | string | required | The CAMEO root category's name (Consult, Protest, Fight...). | — | `"Consult"` |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].CODE` | string | required | The CAMEO root event code (01 to 20). | — | `"04"` |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].EVENTS` | integer | required | The day's events in that category. | — | `23` |
| `CONFLICT_SHARE` | number | required | The share of the day's events in CAMEO's quad classes 3 and 4 (verbal and material conflict). | unit: % | `25.0` |
| `COOPERATION_SHARE` | number | required | The share in quad classes 1 and 2 (verbal and material cooperation). | unit: % | `75.0` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The country's name (Natural Earth). | — | `"Australia"` |
| `DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every row) | The latest day the feed read (the events added to GDELT that day). | — | `"2026-11-05"` |
| `EVENTS` | integer | required | The day's events whose first actor is the country. | — | `92` |
| `EVENTS_WINDOW` | integer | required | The events over the days the history holds. | — | `160` |
| `EVENT_COUNTRY_ID` | string | required | GDELT- and the country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (the CAMEO country code of the event's first actor). | pattern `^GDELT-` | `"GDELT-AUS"` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The country's events and average tone by day over the window, oldest first (DATE, EVENTS, AVG_TONE). | — | [2 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].AVG_TONE` | number | required | GDELT's tone of the articles reporting the events (-100 very negative to +100 very positive; most fall between -10 and +10), weighted by mentions. | unit: tone points (-100 to +100) | `-1.4378` |
| `HISTORY[].DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The day. | — | `"2026-11-04"` |
| `HISTORY[].EVENTS` | integer | required | That day's events whose first actor is the country. | — | `68` |
| `ISO3` | string | required | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, the key the map shades by. | — | `"AUS"` |
| `MENTIONS` | integer | required | How many times those events were mentioned across the day's coverage. | — | `4410` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The country's name (Natural Earth). | — | `"Australia"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: The GDELT Project (https://www.gdeltproject.org/)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The GDELT 1.0 daily event file of the latest day. | — | `"GDELT 1.0 daily events 2026-11-05"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (false for GDELT). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | GDELT's terms of use, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"GDELT terms of use: free and open for any use, commercial …` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The GDELT Project. | — | `"The GDELT Project"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | GDELT's data page. | — | `"https://www.gdeltproject.org/data.html"` |
| `TONE_CHANGE` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The day's average tone less the window's: below zero, coverage turned more negative. | unit: tone points (-100 to +100) | `-0.5098` |
| `TOP_STORIES` | array of objects | required | The day's most-mentioned events' source articles (MENTIONS, URL, CATEGORY), links to the originals. | — | [5 objects] |
| `TOP_STORIES[].CATEGORY` | string | required | The event's CAMEO root category. | — | `"Consult"` |
| `TOP_STORIES[].MENTIONS` | integer | required | How often the event was mentioned. | — | `1211` |
| `TOP_STORIES[].URL` | string | required | The first article GDELT found reporting the event: a link to the publisher's site. | — | `"https://www.bandt.com.au/melbourne-confidential-tiffany-da…` |
| `WINDOW_DAYS` | integer | required | How many days of the window have events for the country. | — | `2` |

### Fields in other rows

None: all 13 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `EVENT_COUNTRY_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `EVENT_COUNTRY_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `EVENTS`, `MENTIONS`, `AVG_GOLDSTEIN`, `CONFLICT_SHARE`, `COOPERATION_SHARE`, `EVENTS_WINDOW`, `WINDOW_DAYS`, `BY_CATEGORY`, `HISTORY`, `TOP_STORIES`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `AVG_TONE`, `AVG_TONE_WINDOW`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `DATE`, `TONE_CHANGE`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `EVENT_COUNTRY_ID` per snapshot.
- `EVENT_COUNTRY_ID` matches `^GDELT-`.
